posts.name: Ameena
posts.cooked:
We play with three heroes (though there's only two of us) and we don't generally find Miss Information too hard - I suppose it's because you need less Clue cards out before she flips. One time we fought her, I played Omni-10 and I felt as though I'd practically soloed her with all my components and stuff :D.

The villains we tend to have less luck against (apart from the obvious Mr Angry Parsons) are Rat, Matriarch, La Capitan, and Kismet. Kismet thrashed us multiple times before we were finally able to beat her once. Villains like the Chairman can be nasty, but that's more due to damage rather than destroying your stuff or stopping you doing stuff...okay, Rat is like that too, but a load of his damage is irreducible. Even Baron Blade can be a total arse sometimes - in fact, lately, it seems like he's been having more luck against us, or something - that bloody Devious Disruption, arrrgh :P.
